description: Defines the EntityReferenceFieldItemList class for managing entity reference fields in Drupal, including validation constraints, entity loading, default value processing, and form submission handling.

classes.name: EntityReferenceFieldItemList
classes.description: A class for managing lists of entity reference field items, including validation, entity loading, default value processing, and form handling.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves validation constraints, adding a 'ValidReference' constraint.

methods.name: referencedEntities
methods.description: Returns the entities referenced by this field, loading existing entities or handling new ones.

methods.name: processDefaultValue
methods.description: Processes default values, converting UUIDs to entity IDs.

methods.name: defaultValuesFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for default values, converting entity IDs to UUIDs for deployability.
